identity_evidence: Kanagawa Institute of Technology identifies KAIT Workshop as a circa 2,000 square metre open making facility planned by architect Junya Ishigami and supported by 305 columns.
The university's Japanese page states that the facility was completed in spring 2008 and supports students' voluntary and creative making activities.

The facility belongs to the university and serves university students as its core users. Outreach science activities for local school pupils are secondary and do not change the primary university function.
